_readme: Curated NASA PDS Perseverance MEDA sensor-reading summaries. Recomputed from the cited calibrated CSV files during the source audit; gameplay rules are separate.
dataset: Mars 2020 Perseverance MEDA, calibrated environment data (PDS4)
method: Take the minimum and maximum of calibrated ATS_LOCAL_TEMP1 samples satisfying 100 < Kelvin < 400; subtract exactly 273.15 using decimal arithmetic; round to 0.1 Celsius with ROUND_HALF_UP. This is a simple recorded-sample summary; additional quality flags are not applied and it is not a derived global-weather product.
kidFact: For the selected MEDA sensor readings on Sol 290, the recorded range was about -3 to -77 Celsius. This is one place and one sol, not the climate of all Mars.
unverified: RDS light-channel interpretation is not established here. No measured dust-to-power conversion is claimed. Raw-source quality flags were not used in this simple temperature summary.
usageInGame: Active Scene 2 science card: recorded temperature variation supports discussion of heaters and battery storage. Fictional mission-profile dust forecasts are separate from these observations.

_provenance.assistanceScope: Initial summary curation with Claude; English translation and recomputation/metadata with ChatGPT/Codex.

citation: J.A. Rodriguez-Manfredi et al. (2021), The Mars Environmental Dynamics Analyzer, MEDA, NASA Planetary Data System, DOI 10.17189/1522849.
